question: Comments loads its data with Suspense. What HTML does renderToString produce for this part?
options: The finished comments, after the data loads
say: Comments loads its data with Suspense. What HTML does render to string produce for this part?
explanation: renderToString doesn't wait. When Comments suspends, it renders the closest Suspense fallback into the HTML. The comments appear only after the client code loads.
explainSay: The loading paragraph. Render to string doesn't wait, so it uses the closest Suspense fallback.
